{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Dark-wash straight-leg jeans, full length with a slightly high rise, deep indigo #2b3a55, heavyweight stretch denim with a fleece-free smooth finish

Thermal long-sleeve base layer top, fitted crew neck, hip length, warm cream #f3e9d8, fine merino wool

Chunky turtleneck sweater, relaxed fit, hip length, rust terracotta #b5532c, soft wool-blend knit

Wool-blend coat, single-breasted, knee length, deep forest green #2f4a3a, brushed wool with a quilted lining

Waterproof leather ankle boots, lace-up with lug sole, round toe, dark chocolate #3e2a20, treated full-grain leather with a warm fleece lining

Wool scarf, wide and long, oatmeal #d8c8ae, soft lambswool

Knitted beanie, snug fit, camel #b98a5a, wool with a soft lining

Leather gloves, wrist length, dark chocolate #3e2a20, leather with a warm lining

Wool socks, mid-calf, charcoal #4a4a4a, thick merino blend

This outfit is built for a snowy walk at three degrees below zero, with layers that hold heat while you stroll and step in and out of cafés. The waterproof lug-sole boots grip wet snow and shrug off road salt, and the dark denim hides splashes while keeping the look neat and everyday. The terracotta sweater and forest green coat sit beautifully with your copper hair and green eyes, and the warm cream and oatmeal tones soften the face. Layers like the thin thermal top are easy to peel off inside the cafés, so you stay comfortable all evening."}],"usage":{"input_tokens":2544,"output_tokens":570},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
